promesa.tagline: Approves, denies with a stated cause or escalates; never denies alone.
promesa.intro: The agent reads the request, asks for what is missing, applies the benefit plan's rules and approves only what the plan allows; the rest goes to an auditor with the evidence and the counter-evidence, and it answers the member with an AI notice.
promesa.para_quien: For an insurer —a synthetic one— that receives prior-authorization requests with the physician's free text and today reviews them by hand, one by one, without knowing which could be decided alone and which needed an auditor.

titular: A medical prior-authorization agent built to a verifiable plan: every path it takes is written in the plan, and a person reviews every denial with the full case in front of them.

bloques.linea: Separates emergencies and exempt services, authorized without a coverage check.
Turns the physician's text into fields, with their confidence.
Asks for what is missing, up to the maximum the plan sets.
Applies the benefit plan's rules, no model.
The rules written in the plan decide whether the case escalates.
An auditor sees the full case before denying.
Writes the reply and the adverse-decision document.
Fixed rules: no sensitive data, no injected order.

pasos.texto: Reviews the full case and decides

anotaciones.texto: No denial goes out without the auditor; in this demo, the auditor was simulated in batch.
If something is still missing after the maximum of clarifications, the case goes to the auditor.
The case's text never decides which action runs.

limites: It decides on synthetic cases: it is a demonstration, not a service.
Its human auditor was simulated in batch, following the known truth.
It runs in batches of 20 cases, outside CI and with breaks between batches.
nunca: Denies without a person reviewing it.
Obeys instructions hidden in a case's text.
Lets a member's data out in the reply.
Asks for authorization for an emergency.
